_comment: P3-D: the contract-3 open-water layer (cells.json tile_water / tile_body) of every shipped structured map, run-length encoded ([value, count] over the row-major data), for tests/deep_water_verdict_diff, which grafts it onto the shipped cells.json. Made from TG contract-3 dumps (tools/headless_dump.gd for the layout maps, windowed sandbox exports for the procedural ones) whose every other cells.json key equals the shipped file. Each map's cells_md5 is the md5 of the shipped <id>_cells.json text (CR bytes dropped) the layer was checked against: a re-exported map fails the diff until it is re-packed. A map whose shipped cells.json carries its own tile_water / tile_body (contract 3, e.g. the Perrow tg_hillside_* water maps) needs no record: the diff strips that layer for OLD and uses the shipped file as NEW, and the packer skips it. Re-pack: python tools/pack_c3_water_layers.py <dir of contract-3 <id>_cells.json> [--merge] (from the project folder); python tools/pack_c3_water_layers.py --check lists the stale maps.
